title: New Neighbours
text:
Last month a new family moved into the flat next to ours. Their names are Mehmet and Leyla, and they have two small children. They came from Kayseri because Mehmet found a job at a hospital in our city.

On their first day, my mother made a big plate of börek and we took it to their door. Leyla was very happy. She invited us in for tea, and we talked for almost two hours. The children were a bit shy at first, but soon they were playing with my little brother.

Now we see each other almost every day. Last Saturday they asked us to dinner, and Leyla cooked a delicious Kayseri dish called mantı. My father said it was the best mantı he had ever eaten. I think we are very lucky to have such friendly neighbours.

ex: We moved into our new flat in May.
